_claude_auth_notes: How the claude CLI is authenticated: "subscription" (the CLI login of the person running the tool; API credentials are removed from child processes and an apiKeyHelper stops the run) or "api_key" (metered API billing; credentials are passed through, nothing is refused). Following the terms of each connected service is the operator's responsibility.

hubspot._notes: PLACEHOLDERS. portal_id builds the record links in the report; owner_id is the owner set on new records (leave it empty to set none). The environment variables HUBSPOT_PORTAL_ID and HUBSPOT_OWNER_ID take precedence.

crawler.user_agent: account-sourcing-pipeline/0.1 (+contact: set this to your own address)
crawler._notes: All three switches are OFF in this public version. user_agent: sent with every request and matched against robots.txt. impersonate_browser: when true, requests use the fetch library's defaults, which present the client as a browser, and robots.txt is matched as "*". stealth_fallback: when true, a page that refuses the first request (401/403/407/429/503 or a bot challenge) is fetched again with a stealth browser built to pass such challenges; when false the site is recorded as blocked and skipped. session_page_fetch: when true, the /qualify session gets page-fetch tools, which fetch any URL the session asks for and do not consult robots.txt; when false the session works from the source pack and web search.

apollo._notes: max_search_pages is the hard search-credit ceiling per run date (1 credit per page with results). enrich is reserved (not implemented in v1, must stay false; /source ignores it). result_field_label: create it by hand in Apollo as an account picklist with values Qualified, Maybe, Not Qualified, Prefiltered, Error; until it exists /register-results writes lists named by result_list_pattern ({result} = qualified|maybe|rejected|prefiltered|error). required_filters: each entry (a|b = either) must be present in search.json filters in net_new_search mode or /source refuses to run; list mode requires account_label_ids. enrich_pushed: after each run, /enrich fills numberofemployees and industry on HubSpot records this pipeline pushed (apollo_organizations_bulk_enrich, 1 credit per matched company, each company at most once; existing HubSpot values are never overwritten). max_enrich_per_call: the credit ceiling of one /enrich call; companies beyond it wait for the next call.
